name: Ultra SEO
author: themeansar

sections.description: Ultra SEO is a simple yet powerful plugin that helps you craft perfect SEO titles for your WordPress content. Whether you’re a blogger, business owner, or developer, Ultra SEO lets you stay focused on what matters: writing compelling, search-friendly titles without the bloat of complex SEO plugins.
sections.faq:
What is the plugin license?

  • This plugin is released under a GPL license.

What themes this plugin supports?

  • The plugin supports all themes.

short_description: Add custom SEO titles with real-time progress feedback to optimize your WordPress content effortlessly.
